items.prompt: Why is a correct atomic attempts count insufficient evidence of a correct reservation service?
items.modelAnswer: It covers one metric only. Need complete shared availability/accepted invariant and synchronized snapshots, validation/identity/rejection policy, lifetime/error/cancellation handling and durable/replay/account semantics if required. Atomicity does not prove business correctness, progress or throughput.

criteria.text: Separates metric correctness from reservation invariant.
Names shared transition and synchronized reads.
Keeps durability/progress/performance claims outside toy evidence.
